author: AndreaAuchincloss
body:
IPR009249 has a GO cross reference for cobalt binding (GO:0050897), which is being propagated into a family of enzymes that don't bind cobalt. See for example Q55891and Q93TN0 both of which have structures, neither binds any metal at all.

There are 66 Swiss-Prot and about 1600 TrEMBL entries (could be fewer, I didn't look at them carefully) that incorrectly have Co-binding GO term.

Best, Andrea
